articles.title: Bitcoin drops as Nvidia cheating scandal and failed Iran talks trigger volatility

articles.title: tBTC bridge partially resumes as $120M Aave reserve remains frozen
articles.snippet: Threshold halted its tBTC bridge on Oct. 30 as operators addressed a critical Linux kernel vulnerability that could allow attackers to execute code on unpatched servers.

articles.title: Suspicious prediction market activity seen before election poll release: NYT
articles.snippet: Bets were placed shortly before two recent New York Times/Siena political polls were released to the public, according to a report.

articles.title: Vitalik Buterin Moves On From ‘Ultrasound Money,’ Says ETH’s Value Is Stability
articles.snippet: The Ethereum co-founder says ETH's value comes from stability, not fee burns, citing its decentralization, censorship resistance and security.
